_why:
#31 — `NO_LINE_PINS = ("design", "plan", "spec")` was declared at :91 and read by NOTHING for the life of the file, while the module docstring and `SKILL.md:2846` both promised the rule and `HARD_KINDS` already listed `LINEPIN`. The arm simply appended to `advisories`, so a `design` document carrying a line pin PASSED. Three sources disagreed and the code was the quietest of them — the documented-rule-not-enforced class.

It looked like a two-line fix and was a MIGRATION. Measured before wiring: 6 live documents carrying 17 line pins pass today and fail after (`exec-path-hardening` plan+design, `pin-agents-tail-banner.design`, `regression-provenance-ledger.design`, `tdd-dispatch-verification-discipline` spec+design). The operator chose to enforce it and exempt `docs/archive/**` rather than repair the documents, narrow the constant, or raise the noise-floor ceiling — that last option being rejected by the noise-floor test's own comment, which records it breaking three times and says raising it 'would buy a few commits and recur'.

Two tests here asserted the OPPOSITE and were deliberately moved, not quietly edited: one argued 'a gate that fails every real document is not a gate', which is exactly the cost the operator weighed.

mutations.name: the-constant-goes-dead-again
mutations._mechanism: Restores the defect exactly: `NO_LINE_PINS` declared, promised by two documents, and consulted by nothing — a `design` document carrying a line pin passes.
mutations.find:
if phase not in NO_LINE_PINS:
        return False

mutations.name: the-archive-exemption-is-removed
mutations._mechanism: THE reason this row was a policy question. An archived document cannot be repaired — its pins rot as the tree moves under it — so a hard rule there measures elapsed time, not authorship. `docs/archive/**` also holds the noise-floor calibration corpus whose hard-finding count is ceiling-asserted.
mutations.find: return not any(part == "archive" for part in doc.resolve().parts)

mutations.name: every-phase-forbids-a-line-pin
mutations._mechanism: The over-correction. `impl-plan` is deliberately NOT in NO_LINE_PINS — its author contract permits a pin — and making every phase hard would fail the corpus wholesale while looking like stricter enforcement. It also re-scores the cannot-judge direction, where 'I could not check' would be reported as 'it is broken'.
mutations.find:
if phase not in NO_LINE_PINS:
        return False
